question: A parallel plate capacitor has capacitance $10\text{ pF}$ in air. It is charged to a fixed charge of $60\text{ pC}$ and then disconnected from the source. Dielectrics of constants $K_1 = 2$ and $K_2 = 6$ are separately inserted fully between the plates. Compare the capacitance and potential difference in the two cases.
